notes: Page title at capture: '[0.5] WHIRLING Trinity Martial Artist Monk Build - League Starter to Endgame'. Item data and trade queries come from the page's preloaded build-variant state. For every tab and weapon set, the trade links in the Equipment grid matched that state exactly (checked after clicking each tab and Set 1/Set 2).

Every guide query sets status 'securable' (instant buyout only). The pob2 server always searches status 'available', so offline and in-person listings can appear; this is listed under 'unmapped' on each slot.

divineEq is the server's poe.ninja conversion. cheapestDiv is the lowest divineEq among the listings returned, because the trade site orders by its own currency ratios, not poe.ninja's. median5to10Div is the median divineEq of listings 5-10 in the order the trade site returned them.
A rare jewel socketed twice in the passive tree appears once in the gear grid; it is one slot with quantity 2 and treeNodes.
Slots that share a query with an earlier slot reuse that result instead of making another call. No seller names or listing ids are recorded.

Unpriced slots have searchArgs null, found null and empty listings. Pricing them would use the same mapping: category -> item_type, each 'and' stat filter -> a mods entry, query.name -> item_name with item_rarity 'unique', query.type -> item_type.
